I came for a Thai massage at Avani Well. The staff member, named P' Na, gave me a great massage and focused on specific areas. Before the massage, they gave me a form to fill out with my name and the specific areas of my body I wanted to focus on. I told them I wanted to focus on my neck and shoulders. After filling in the details, they took me to the massage room on the second floor. When I found the massage room, it was amazing! They use a spa massage room with a spa massage bed so I could sleep comfortably and breathe easily. They really pay attention to every detail of the customer. They start by having me lie face down, starting from my shoulders. They slowly and patiently massage my shoulders and back until both sides are done. Then, they apply a hot compress, making me feel even more comfortable and relaxed. In addition to the comfortable shoulder massage, they also massage other parts of my body, such as my legs and arms. The pressure was excellent. I fell asleep during the massage and woke up feeling recharged. After the massage, the staff member served tea in different colors for the day. We went on Saturday and it was roselle tea. The tea was delicious and fragrant and they came with two small snacks. Overall, I really like this spa. It's worth the price for the massage. I felt that it really hit the aching spots and relieved the pain. The staff member is really attentive and dedicated to the massage. I'm telling you, I definitely have to come back here again.
